about: Tables the stagers refused to reconstruct from pdftotext output, completed from a reviewer's reading of the pdf.js-rendered page. Applied by tools/build_srd_catalog.js only while the staging text still hashes to textSha256. 'rows' are transcribed cells (every word must occur in the entry's own text); 'anchors' give the roll labels in order with the first words of each outcome, and the outcome text is sliced from the entry's own printed lines, so nothing is invented. See docs/SRD5_1_COVERAGE_MANIFEST.md section 6.
